people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
translations.bsb: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, then Christ died for nothing.
translations.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
translations.asv: I do not make void the grace of God: for if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nought.
